def clean(df):
    d = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    d = d.drop_duplicates()
    # normalize text labels (whitespace/case variants)
    for c in ['penguin_id', 'species', 'island', 'sex']:
        if c in d.columns:
            d[c] = d[c].astype('string').str.strip().str.capitalize() if c in ['species', 'island'] else d[c].astype('string').str.strip()
    d['sex'] = d['sex'].astype('string').str.strip().str.lower()
    d.loc[~d['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']), 'sex'] = pd.NA
    # body_mass_g: numbers written as text (with commas) -> numeric
    d['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        d['body_mass_g'].astype('string').str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce')
    # out-of-range body mass (rule: 2500-6500 g) -> invalid
    d.loc[(d['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (d['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # flipper_length_mm: negative / out of range (170-235) -> invalid
    d['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(d['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    d.loc[(d['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (d['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    return d


def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    g = d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
